description:
This Ad Film presents a joint pain relief oil through a clear, story-driven ad film created entirely without any physical shoot by our creative specialts.

You’ll see an AI actor experiencing knee pain, 3D product model shown in 360°, visual representations of how the oil works and effective pain-free results.

Every product model, environment, animation, and character is produced using our unique proprietary CGI, VFX & AI production pipeline powered by our high-end GPU computers, enabling brands to create high-end appliance ad films without studios, cameras, or live production. Even before we start production, our AI-powered CGI experts use shared and available product images to create perfect digital double / precise 3D model of client’s product for product accuracy in the final video

🔗 Learn more: https://www.v4b.ai
📩 Business inquiries: grow@v4b.ai

V4b.ai is an Agency creating Content & Videos Without Any Physical Shoot, using high-end GPU Computers powering CGI, VFX, and AI, operated by specialists. Our production-grade pipelines outperform prompt-based GenAI platforms, delivering cinematic Ad Films, eCommerce Videos, and more from Concept to Final Cut. 

From Concept to Final Cut, we create Ad Films - Our custom production tech-stack helps our creative team with realistic environments, lifelike AI humans, multi-language voiceovers and dialogues. No sets. No actors. Just Platform-Optimized Films ready for Youtube, Meta, TV, OTT & more.

eCommerce/D2C Listing Videos - Most D2C buyers abandon eCom pages without completing a purchase as they aren’t convinced by images alone. Even before we start production, our AI-powered CGI experts use shared and available product images to create perfect digital double / precise 3D model of client’s product for product accuracy in the final video, then producing Marketplace-Optimized Videos & Images, that increase ‘Add-to-Cart’ by building customer trust, ready to get listed on Amazon, Shopify & more.
